# Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic

> Dermatologist-led skin, hair, laser and aesthetic clinic with two locations in Delhi NCR: Sector 76, Noida (Amrapali Silicon City) and Raj Nagar Extension, Ghaziabad (Quantum Homes). Led by Dr. Aarushi Tyagi.

Website: https://revivaskinandsurgery.com/

## Clinics
- [Noida clinic](https://revivaskinandsurgery.com/noida): Amrapali Silicon City, Gate No. 4, Sector 76, Noida. Phone +91 85958 56844
- [Ghaziabad clinic](https://revivaskinandsurgery.com/ghaziabad): Quantum Homes, Raj Nagar Extension, Ghaziabad 201017. Phone +91 78274 48711
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 11:00 AM – 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM – 7:30 PM
